claim: Every Alpaca entry in the window was followed by a naked_rearm of its protection 6.1-7.0 minutes after entry, including all 3 real-money alpaca_live entries, although execution sends each entry as a bracket/OTO with GTC legs.
evidence: curl .../api/diag/journal?table=trades&limit=1000&offset={0,1000,2000}&envelope=true (10:18Z; 3000 rows, ids 3287-6286, total_rows 6286) filtered account_id LIKE 'alpaca%' AND status!='rejected' AND created_at>='2026-09-15': alpaca_live n=3 rearm_within_30m=3 gaps_min [6.2,6.4,6.6]; alpaca_paper n=9 rearm 7 gaps [6.2..7.0]; alpaca_portfolio n=8 rearm 7 gaps [6.1..6.4]. Every repair row: protection_repair_last_kind='naked_rearm', protection_repair_last_verified='unverified'. Trade ids alpaca_live: 5875 SLV, 5924 TLT, 6097 IAUM. src/units/accounts/alpaca_client.py:563-593 sets order_class bracket/oto and time_in_force gtc.
expected: A bracket entry is protected from its fill, and no naked re-arm fires on a correctly bracketed entry.
actual: 17 of 20 Alpaca entries since 2026-09-15 (3 of 3 alpaca_live) were graded naked by the equity naked-sweep about 6 minutes after entry and re-armed; each re-arm is recorded 'unverified'. Either the positions were venue-naked for ~6 min after every fill, or the sweep misgrades the bracket's own child legs (e.g. Alpaca 'held' stop child) as absent and adds a second set of legs. Which one could not be read: no Alpaca order-history surface exists (see SA-AUD-1-alpaca-order-history-unreadable).
population: Alpaca trades opened 2026-09-15..2026-09-29 in the trades journal, non-rejected, n=20 (alpaca_live 3, alpaca_paper 9, alpaca_portfolio 8)
detector: none today. Proposed: a soak row per Alpaca entry recording venue legs (GET /v2/orders?status=all&nested=true) at fill+10s and at first sweep, and a guard that fails when naked_rearm fires within 15 min of an entry on >50% of entries.
proposed_fix: judgment: (a) read the equity naked-sweep's leg classification (src/runtime/order_monitor.py _check_broker_naked_equity_positions and AlpacaClient.protection_state, alpaca_client.py:~1786-1840) against a live bracket's child statuses (held/new/accepted), and count a 'held' bracket stop child as resting if the venue will trigger it; or (b) if the venue really drops the legs, fix placement. Decide which only after reading /v2/orders?status=all for trades 6097/5875/5924.

claim: No read surface exists for Alpaca order history, and the journal records no Alpaca leg ids, so whether a real-money alpaca_live position had a resting stop at any past instant cannot be established from the venue.
evidence: grep -n '@router.get' src/web/api/routers/diag.py -> Alpaca routes: only /alpaca_open_orders (current open orders + positions). Bybit has /bybit_raw_order_history; Alpaca has no sibling. curl .../api/diag/journal?table=trades&limit=1000&offset={0,1000,2000}&envelope=true (10:18Z; 3000 rows, ids 3287-6286, total_rows 6286): alpaca_live rows with sl_order_id: 0 of 3; alpaca_paper+alpaca_portfolio: 0 of 133.
expected: For each real-money position, the venue's order history (order ids, types, statuses, fill times) can be read after the position closes, and the journal carries the protective legs' ids so they can be looked up.
actual: Only the current open-order set is readable. At 09:53Z it was empty (alpaca_live 0 positions, 0 orders), so none of the 3 alpaca_live positions in the window can be traced across their life.
population: alpaca_live real-money trades open at any point 2026-09-22..29, n=3 (5875, 5924, 6097)
detector: none possible until the surface exists; then check_soak_registered-style guard that each venue with a live account has an order-history diag route.
proposed_fix: Add read-only GET /api/diag/alpaca_order_history?account_id&symbol&after&until wrapping GET /v2/orders?status=all&nested=true&symbols=..&after=..; persist bracket child leg ids to trades.sl_order_id/tp_order_id at entry (alpaca_client.place result legs). Tier 1 for the route, Tier 2 for the write.

claim: alpaca_live trades 6097 (IAUM) and 5875 (SLV) went flat at the venue between the 13:30Z open and 13:31:33Z on 2026-09-28, below their journal stops, and were journaled exit_reason 'exchange_flat_reconciled' rather than as stop exits.
evidence: curl .../api/diag/journalctl?unit=ict-trader-live.service&since=2026-09-28T13:28:00Z&until=2026-09-28T13:34:00Z -> 13:31:33 'account_open_positions(alpaca_live): alpaca empty snapshot verified' ; 'ARMED snapshot close-confirm trade_id=6097 IAUM' and 'trade_id=5875 SLV'; 13:33:37 'CLOSED via position-snapshot reconcile' both. Journal: 6097 stop_loss 41.979 exit 41.2732 (1.68% beyond); 5875 stop_loss 55.411 exit 55.3132 (0.18% beyond); sl_order_id NULL both; notes closed_by position_snapshot_reconciler. 13:29:00-13:31:34 window has no naked-sweep line for alpaca_live.
expected: A venue stop fill is journaled as a stop exit with the venue's fill, and whether a resting stop existed is answerable from the venue.
actual: Both closed as reconciler flat-closes. The exits happened at the open, before the app's own SL check, and at a price beyond the stop. That fits a resting stop gapping through at the open, but whether a stop existed at the venue could not be read (no Alpaca order-history surface). Answer to the lead's question: could-not-look at the venue; indirect evidence is consistent with a stop fill.
population: alpaca_live closes in window, n=3; 2 of 3 closed this way (5924 closed sl_cross)
detector: none; the reconciler cannot tell a stop fill from any other flat without an order-status reader for Alpaca (its own note says 'integration has no per-order status reader (non-Bybit)').
proposed_fix: With SA-AUD-1-alpaca-order-history-unreadable in place, have the snapshot reconciler look up the flat symbol's filled orders since the trade opened and stamp exit_reason sl/tp from the filled leg's type (src/runtime/order_monitor.py _reconcile_orphan_exchange_positions).

detector: none; proposed: a soak comparing live vs mirror close time and reason per package, alarm when they differ by reason class.
proposed_fix: judgment: read /v2/orders?status=all for alpaca_portfolio SLV around 2026-09-28T13:30Z once the history route exists, then decide between a protection-placement fix and a documented paper-simulation caveat on the Gate-2 read.
